items.title: Who Is Martin Mull?
items.overview: Discover Martin Mull's restless reinvention from smoky folk clubs to primetime sitcoms to gallery walls, told in his own words and by the friends who watched it happen, including Steve Martin, Tom Waits, David Alan Grier and others.

items.title: Love of Your Life
items.overview: After a chance encounter sparks a sweeping romance, Maya's future is suddenly upended, sending her on an unexpected journey to love and live again.

items.title: Jamie Foxx: Take Care of Yourself
items.overview: Jamie Foxx az idővel csak jobb lesz. A "Jamie Foxx: Vigyázz magadra" egy jó adag nevetésterápia, amelyben a sztár eddigi legőszintébb, legkiforrottabb és legfelejthetetlenebb arcát mutatja.

items.title: Eine Krankheit wie ein Gedicht
items.overview: Jelena Ilić's father suffers from drug-induced psychosis and has been in forensic psychiatry for five years. Now the day of his release is approaching. How can the director be sure that her father will not relapse and become violent again? How can a reconciliation be achieved? And how can society successfully reintegrate a mentally ill offender?

items.title: Robu 404
items.overview: Der neunjährige Can meistert dank seines selbstgebauten KI-Roboters "Robu 404" nicht nur technische Hürden, sondern entdeckt Mut, Selbstvertrauen und echte Freundschaft. Türkischer Animationsfilm.

items.title: Állatok
items.overview: Egy Los Angeles-i polgármesterjelölt és felesége igyekeznek összeszedni az elrabolt fiuk váltságdíját, miközben olyan döntéseket hoznak, amik darabokra törhetik az életüket.

items.title: Zogsool
items.overview: The vast Mongolian grassland stretches across the screen, with blue skies and beautiful clouds filling half the frame. Underneath, an oil tanker truck drives for some time along a scenic road, before coming to a stop in front of a small town. When the town is suddenly sealed off due to the COVID pandemic, Sumber, the oil tanker driver, is quarantined at the gas station. Khanda, a single mother who manages the station while being exploited for sex and labor by a corrupt government official and the greedy owner, is now also tasked with looking after Sumber.

items.title: Free Leonard Peltier
items.overview: Leonard Peltier, an activist jailed for decades after a disputed conviction, faces his twilight years as a new generation fights for his release from prison before it's too late.

items.title: Theatre Hauntings - West End Ghouls
items.overview: Ghostly sightings, haunted theatres and tragic legends collide in London's West End as eyewitnesses and dramatic reconstructions explore the chilling stories behind some of theatreland's most famous hauntings.

items.title: Theatre Hauntings - Dark Knights on Broadway
items.overview: Broadway's brightest theatres hide dark secrets. From Olive Thomas to William Frohman, this documentary explores the tragic true stories and ghostly legends said to haunt New York's theatre district.

items.title: Last Chance Motel
items.overview: A newlywed couple's dream wedding spirals into a bloody nightmare when they uncover that their secluded venue- a desolate motel deep in the Nevada desert- is run by a relentless bloodthirsty family with dark secrets, revealing that one bride's future may not be all that it was promised to be.

items.title: Fatima
items.overview: Fatima is a model student at her strict school and an obedient daughter to her overprotective father. But in secret, she smokes and trains her voice, developing real singing talent. In a society where singing in public is taboo, she can never let her guard down.

items.title: The Beast
items.overview: When a militia of unidentified hostiles coordinates a coup against the U.S., the president uncovers the extent of The Beast's highly classified offensive capabilities in order to save his life and America.

items.title: Angel and the Badman
items.overview: A wounded outlaw finds unexpected mercy in the care of a rancher's daughter. The hope of love pulls him toward a different life until the law, and his violent past, close in on his new home. Now he must choose the kind of man he'll become.

items.title: The Spirit of Halloween
items.overview: Brilliant bridal designer Everly Stone has no patience for Halloween, especially the beloved fire-station bash that once left her heartbroken in front of everyone she knew, but when her late mentor appears with a glamorous warning, Everly Stone is swept through one unforgettable night by three mischievous spirits who reveal the joy she lost, the people she’s pushing away, and the future she might miss if she keeps hiding behind work and fear. With a loyal assistant ready for more, a town waiting to welcome her back, and longtime friend Beau Madison still carrying a spark from their past, Everly Stone must decide whether Halloween is the night that broke her heart or the one that can finally help it heal.

items.title: Kashpirovsky - Under the Spell
items.overview: The film tells the remarkable story of Dr Anatoly Kashpirovsky, who, at the height of his career, claimed to anaesthetise three women remotely for major surgery through the sheer force of his persuasion. His televised healing séances, broadcast across the Soviet bloc, broke viewing records, reaching hundreds of millions of people. Loved by his followers and despised by his enemies, Kashpirovsky became an unlikely symbol of a world undergoing radical political transformation.
